title: Next epic: claude-sub's first live cloud run, post-merge proof of v5t [A1]
body:
v5t's [A1] (a config: claude epic runs its workers on sonnet/opus via the subscription in the cloud, stepping down to Workers AI) is built and tested at the seam but has never run: the factory deploys main only. Proposed epic, per the planning learnings: (1) first ticks: 8qi (bump the image's claude CLI so the aliases resolve to 5.5) and a NAMED operator step setting at least one CLAUDE_SUB_TOKEN_<LABEL> Worker secret; (2) uuk (rival worker past the 2h lease TTL) and eov (a claude config with no token passes silently when the factory cannot be asked) before the run; (3) a named tick INSIDE the epic runs a real `config: claude` epic in the cloud and a GLM epic beside it, comparing escalation and cost on status; (4) km9, 5ww, 0iu, lrb, oqn, 2zs, k20, jwq, and o3f closing bw7 as the tail; (5) 7vp/lxo so a routing-file deliverable is never again a dispatched tick. Acceptance: the live claude run completes with workers on the subscription and a forced full pool steps one job down to GLM 5.3, visible in the run feed.
evidence: image/Dockerfile:53 ARG CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION=2.1.227; .tick/issues/8qi.json, uuk.json, eov.json; docs/v5t-closeout-retro-2026-10-07.md
demonstrating_check: ticfac run <an epic labelled config: claude> --cloud (post-merge, on the deployed factory)
